--src: Mathlib.FieldTheory.PerfectClosure
theorem natCast (n x : ℕ) : (x : PerfectClosure K p) = mk K p (n, x) := by
  induction' n with n ih
  · induction' x with x ih
    · simp
    rw [Nat.cast_succ, Nat.cast_succ, ih]
    rfl
  rw [ih]; apply Quot.sound
  -- Porting note: was `conv`
  suffices R K p (n, (x : K)) (Nat.succ n, frobenius K p (x : K)) by
    rwa [frobenius_natCast K p x] at this
  apply R.intro

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.Padics.RingHoms
theorem toZModPow_eq_iff_ext {R : Type*} [NonAssocSemiring R] {g g' : R →+* ℤ_[p]} :
    (∀ n, (toZModPow n).comp g = (toZModPow n).comp g') ↔ g = g' := by
  constructor
  · intro hg
    ext x : 1
    apply ext_of_toZModPow.mp
    intro n
    show (toZModPow n).comp g x = (toZModPow n).comp g' x
    rw [hg n]
  · rintro rfl _
    rfl
